Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ أَعَنْتَنِيْ عَلَى خَتْمِ كِتَابِكَ
Translation: O Allah, You have helped me complete Your Book

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ نُورًا وَجَعَلْتَهُ مُهَيْمِنًا
Translation: Which You have sent down as a light and made it a guardian

Arabic text: عَلَى كُلِّ كِتَابٍ أَنْزَلْتَهُ
Translation: Over every book You have revealed

Arabic text: وَفَضَّلْتَهُ عَلَى كُلِّ حَدِيثٍ قَصَصْتَهُ
Translation: And You have preferred it over every narrative You have related

Arabic text: وَفُرْقَانًا فَرَقْتَ بِهِ بَيْنَ حَلَالِكَ وَحَرَامِكَ
Translation: And a criterion by which You distinguished between what is lawful and what is forbidden

Arabic text: وَقُرْآنًا أَعْرَبْتَ بِهِ عَنْ شَرَائِعِ أَحْكَامِكَ
Translation: And a Quran through which You explained the laws of Your commandments

Arabic text: وَكِتَابًا فَصَّلْتَهُ لِعِبَادِكَ تَفْصِيلًا
Translation: And a book which You have detailed for Your servants in detail

Arabic text: وَوَحْيًا أَنْزَلْتَهُ عَلَى نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ تَنْزِيلًا
Translation: And a revelation which You sent down to Your Prophet Muhammad, may Your blessings be upon him and his family

Arabic text: وَجَعَلْتَهُ نُورًا نَهْتَدِيْ مِنْ ظُلَمِ الضَّلَالَةِ وَالْجَهَالَةِ بِاتِّبَاعِهِ
Translation: And You made it a light by which we can be guided from the darkness of misguidance and ignorance by following it

Arabic text: وَشِفَاءً لِمَنْ أَنْصَتَ بِفَهْمِ التَّصْدِيقِ إِلَى اسْتِمَاعِهِ
Translation: And a healing for those who listen with understanding and belief to its recitation

Arabic text: وَمِيزَانَ قِسْطٍ لَا يَحِيفُ عَنِ الْحَقِّ لِسَانُهُ
Translation: And a scale of justice whose tongue does not deviate from the truth

Arabic text: وَنُورَ هُدًى لَا يَطْفَأُ عَنِ الشَّاهِدِيْنَ بُرْهَانُهُ
Translation: And a light of guidance whose proof is not extinguished for those who witness it

Arabic text: وَعَلَمَ نَجَاةٍ لَا يَضِلُّ مَنْ أَمَّ قَصْدَ سُنَّتِهِ
Translation: And a flag of salvation, whoever follows the path of its tradition will not go astray

Arabic text: وَلَا تَنَالُ أَيْدِيْ الْهَلَكَاتِ مَنْ تَعَلَّقَ بِعُرْوَةِ عِصْمَتِهِ
Translation: And the hands of destruction cannot reach whoever clings to the handle of its protection

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ فَإِذْ أَفَدْتَنَا الْمَعُونَةَ عَلَى تِلَاوَتِهِ
Translation: O Allah, as You have granted us help in its recitation

Arabic text: وَسَهَّلْتَ جَوَاسِيَ أَلْسِنَتِنَا بِحُسْنِ عِبَارَتِهِ
Translation: And made our tongues eloquent with its beautiful expressions

Arabic text: فَاجْعَلْنَا مِمَّنْ يَرْعَاهُ حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهِ
Translation: So make us among those who observe it with due observance

Arabic text: وَيَدِينُ لَكَ بِاعْتِقَادِ التَّسْلِيمِ لِمُحْكَمِ آيَاتِهِ
Translation: And who believe in submitting to its definitive verses

Arabic text: وَيَفْزَعُ إِلَى الْإِقْرَارِ بِمُتَشَابِهِهِ وَمُوضَحَاتِ بَيِّنَاتِهِ
Translation: And who seek refuge in acknowledging its ambiguous verses and clear evidences

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْزَلْتَهُ عَلَى نَبِيِّكَ
Translation: O Allah, You revealed it to Your Prophet

Arabic text: مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ مُجْمَلًا
Translation: Muhammad, peace be upon him and his family, in summary

Arabic text: وَأَلْهَمْتَهُ عِلْمَ عَجَائِبِهِ مُكَمَّلًا
Translation: And inspired him with the knowledge of its wonders completely

Arabic text: وَوَرَّثْتَنَا عِلْمَهُ مُفَسَّرًا
Translation: And You made us inherit its knowledge in explanation

Arabic text: وَفَضَّلْتَنَا عَلَى مَنْ جَهِلَ عِلْمَهُ
Translation: And You favored us over those who are ignorant of its knowledge

Arabic text: وَقَوَّيْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ لِتَرْفَعَنَا فَوْقَ مَنْ لَمْ يُطِقْ حَمْلَهُ
Translation: And You strengthened us with it to raise us above those who cannot bear its weight

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ فَكَمَا جَعَلْتَ قُلُوبَنَا لَهُ حَمَلَةً
Translation: O Allah, as You have made our hearts carriers of it

Arabic text: وَعَرَّفْتَنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ شَرَفَهُ وَفَضْلَهُ
Translation: And by Your mercy made known to us its nobility and excellence

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ الْخَطِيبِ بِهِ
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad who delivered it

Arabic text: وَعَلَى آلِهِ الْخُزَّانِ لَهُ
Translation: And upon his family who are its treasurers

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْنَا مِمَّنْ يَعْتَرِفُ بِأَنَّهُ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ
Translation: And make us among those who confess that it is from You

Arabic text: حَتَّى لَا يُعَارِضَنَا الشَّكُّ فِيْ تَصْدِيقِهِ
Translation: So that no doubt confronts us in believing it

Arabic text: وَلَا يَخْتَلِجَنَا الزَّيْغُ عَنْ قَصْدِ طَرِيقِهِ
Translation: And no deviation takes us away from its intended path

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْنَا مِمَّنْ يَعْتَصِمُ بِحَبْلِهِ
Translation: And make us among those who hold fast to its rope

Arabic text: وَيَأْوِيْ مِنَ الْمُتَشَابِهَاتِ إِلَى حِرْزِ مَعْقِلِهِ
Translation: And who take refuge from uncertainties in the security of its stronghold

Arabic text: وَيَسْكُنُ فِيْ ظِلِّ جَنَاحِهِ
Translation: And who dwell in the shade of its wing

Arabic text: وَيَهْتَدِيْ بِضَوْءِ صَبَاحِهِ
Translation: And who are guided by the light of its morning

Arabic text: وَيَقْتَدِيْ بِتَبَلُّجِ إِسْفَارِهِ
Translation: And who follow the brightness of its radiance

Arabic text: وَيَسْتَصْبِحُ بِمِصْبَاحِهِ
Translation: And who seek illumination from its lamp

Arabic text: وَلَا يَلْتَمِسُ الْهُدَى فِيْ غَيْرِهِ
Translation: And who do not seek guidance from any other source

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَكَمَا نَصَبْتَ بِهِ مُحَمَّدًا عَلَمًا لِلدَّلَالَةِ عَلَيْكَ
Translation: O Allah, just as You appointed Muhammad as a flag to guide to You

Arabic text: وَأَنْهَجْتَ بِآلِهِ سُبُلَ الرِّضَا إِلَيْكَ
Translation: And through his family You made clear the paths of Your pleasure

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلِ الْقُرْآنَ وَسِيْلَةً لَنَا إِلَى أَشْرَفِ مَنَازِلِ الْكَرَامَةِ
Translation: And make the Quran a means for us to reach the most noble stations of honor

Arabic text: وَسُلَّمًا نَعْرُجُ فِيهِ إِلَى مَحَلِّ السَّلَامَةِ
Translation: And a ladder by which we may ascend to the place of safety

Arabic text: وَسَبَبًا نُجْزَى بِهِ النَّجَاةَ فِيْ عَرْصَةِ الْقِيَامَةِ
Translation: And a cause for which we may be rewarded with salvation on the Day of Resurrection

Arabic text: وَذَرِيْعَةً نَقْدَمُ بِهَا عَلَى نَعِيمِ دَارِ الْمُقَامَةِ
Translation: And a means by which we may proceed to the bliss of the Eternal Abode

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَاحْطُطْ بِالْقُرْآنِ عَنَّا ثِقْلَ الْأَوْزَارِ
Translation: And relieve us, through the Quran, of the burden of sins

Arabic text: وَهَبْ لَنَا حُسْنَ شَمَائِلِ الْأَبْرَارِ
Translation: And grant us the good character of the righteous

Arabic text: وَاقْفُ بِنَا آثَارَ الَّذِيْنَ قَامُوْا لَكَ بِهِ
Translation: And make us follow in the footsteps of those who stood before You with it

Arabic text: آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَأَطْرَافَ النَّهَارِ
Translation: During the hours of the night and the ends of the day

Arabic text: حَتَّى تُطَهِّرَنَا مِنْ كُلِّ دَنَسٍ بِتَطْهِيرِهِ
Translation: Until You purify us from every impurity through its purification

Arabic text: وَتَقْفُوَ بِنَا آثَارَ الَّذِيْنَ اسْتَضَاؤُوْا بِنُوْرِهِ
Translation: And make us follow the footsteps of those who sought light from its illumination

Arabic text: وَلَمْ يُلْهِهِمُ الْأَمَلُ عَنِ الْعَمَلِ فَيَقْطَعَهُمْ بِخُدَعِ غُرُورِهِ
Translation: And were not distracted by false hopes from action, thus being cut off by the deceptions of its delusion

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلِ الْقُرْآنَ لَنَا فِيْ ظُلَمِ اللَّيَالِيْ مُونِسًا
Translation: And make the Quran our companion in the darkness of nights

Arabic text: وَمِنْ نَزَغَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ وَخَطَرَاتِ الْوَسَاوِسِ حَارِسًا
Translation: And a guardian against the promptings of Satan and the whispers of evil thoughts

Arabic text: وَلِأَقْدَامِنَا عَنْ نَقْلِهَا إِلَى الْمَعَاصِيْ حَابِسًا
Translation: And a restraint for our feet from moving toward acts of disobedience

Arabic text: وَلِأَلْسِنَتِنَا عَنِ الْخَوْضِ فِيْ الْبَاطِلِ مِنْ غَيْرِ مَا آفَةٍ مُخْرِسًا
Translation: And a silencer for our tongues from plunging into falsehood without any affliction

Arabic text: وَلِجَوَارِحِنَا عَنِ اقْتِرَافِ الْآثَامِ زَاجِرًا
Translation: And a deterrent for our limbs from committing sins

Arabic text: وَلِمَا طَوَتِ الْغَفْلَةُ عَنَّا مِنْ تَصَفُّحِ الِاعْتِبَارِ نَاشِرًا
Translation: And a means to unfold what heedlessness has folded away from us of the examination of lessons

Arabic text: حَتَّى تُوصِلَ إِلَى قُلُوبِنَا فَهْمَ عَجَائِبِهِ
Translation: Until You convey to our hearts the understanding of its wonders

Arabic text: وَزَوَاجِرَ أَمْثَالِهِ الَّتِيْ ضَعُفَتِ الْجِبَالُ الرَّوَاسِي
Translation: And the cautionary examples which even the firm mountains

Arabic text: عَلَى صَلَابَتِهَا عَنِ احْتِمَالِهِ
Translation: In their solidity are too weak to bear

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَأَدِمْ بِالْقُرْآنِ صَلَاحَ ظَاهِرِنَا
Translation: And through the Quran, maintain the righteousness of our outward selves

Arabic text: وَاحْجُبْ بِهِ خَطَرَاتِ الْوَسَاوِسِ عَنْ صِحَّةِ ضَمَائِرِنَا
Translation: And through it, veil the suggestions of evil whispers from the soundness of our inner selves

Arabic text: وَاغْسِلْ بِهِ دَرَنَ قُلُوبِنَا وَعَلَائِقَ أَوْزَارِنَا
Translation: And wash away with it the stains of our hearts and the consequences of our sins

Arabic text: وَاجْمَعْ بِهِ مُنْتَشَرَ أُمُورِنَا
Translation: And gather through it our scattered affairs

Arabic text: وَأَرْوِ بِهِ فِيْ مَوْقِفِ الْعَرْضِ عَلَيْكَ ظَمَأَ هَوَاجِرِنَا
Translation: And quench with it, on the day of our presentation before You, the thirst of our scorching heat

Arabic text: وَاكْسُنَا بِهِ حُلَلَ الْأَمَانِ يَوْمَ الْفَزَعِ الْأَكْبَرِ فِيْ نُشُورِنَا
Translation: And clothe us through it with the garments of security on the day of the greatest terror at our resurrection

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَاجْبُرْ بِالْقُرْآنِ خَلَّتَنَا مِنْ عَدَمِ الْإِمْلَاقِ
Translation: And through the Quran, compensate our poverty and need

Arabic text: وَسُقْ إِلَيْنَا بِهِ رَغَدَ الْعَيْشِ وَخِصْبَ سَعَةِ الْأَرْزَاقِ
Translation: And drive toward us through it the abundance of comfortable life and the fertility of plentiful provisions

Arabic text: وَجَنِّبْنَا بِهِ الضَّرَائِبَ الْمَذْمُومَةَ وَمَدَانِيَ الْأَخْلَاقِ
Translation: And through it, keep us away from blameworthy qualities and ignoble morals

Arabic text: وَاعْصِمْنَا بِهِ مِنْ هُوَّةِ الْكُفْرِ وَدَوَاعِيْ النِّفَاقِ
Translation: And preserve us through it from the abyss of disbelief and the motives of hypocrisy

Arabic text: حَتَّى يَكُونَ لَنَا فِيْ الْقِيَامَةِ إِلَى رِضْوَانِكَ وَجِنَانِكَ قَائِدًا
Translation: Until it becomes for us on the Day of Resurrection a leader to Your pleasure and Your gardens

Arabic text: وَلَنَا فِيْ الدُّنْيَا عَنْ سَخَطِكَ وَتَعَدِّيْ حُدُودِكَ ذَائِدًا
Translation: And a barrier for us in this world against Your wrath and transgression of Your boundaries

Arabic text: وَلِمَا عِنْدَكَ بِتَحْلِيلِ حَلَالِهِ وَتَحْرِيمِ حَرَامِهِ شَاهِدًا
Translation: And a witness to what is with You through permitting what it permits and forbidding what it forbids

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَهَوِّنْ بِالْقُرْآنِ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ عَلَى أَنْفُسِنَا كَرْبَ السِّيَاقِ
Translation: And through the Quran, make easy for us at death the distress of the driving of the soul

Arabic text: وَجَهْدَ الْأَنِينِ وَتَرَادُفَ الْحَشَارِجِ
Translation: And the exertion of moaning and the succession of the rattling of the throat

Arabic text: إِذَا بَلَغَتِ النُّفُوسُ التَّرَاقِيَ وَقِيلَ مَنْ رَاقٍ
Translation: When souls reach the throats and it is said, "Who can cure him?"

Arabic text: وَتَجَلَّى مَلَكُ الْمَوْتِ لِقَبْضِهَا مِنْ حُجُبِ الْغُيُوبِ
Translation: And the Angel of Death appears to seize them from behind the veils of the unseen

Arabic text: وَرَمَاهَا عَنْ قَوْسِ الْمَنَايَا بِأَسْهُمِ وَحْشَةِ الْفِرَاقِ
Translation: And shoots them from the bow of death with the arrows of the terror of separation

Arabic text: وَدَافَ لَهَا مِنْ ذُعَافِ الْمَوْتِ كَأْسًا مَسْمُومَةَ الْمَذَاقِ
Translation: And mixes for them from the venom of death a cup poisoned to the taste

Arabic text: وَدَنَا مِنَّا إِلَى الْآخِرَةِ رَحِيلٌ وَانْطِلَاقٌ
Translation: And the journey to the Hereafter draws near with departure and setting off

Arabic text: وَصَارَتِ الْأَعْمَالُ قَلَائِدَ فِيْ الْأَعْنَاقِ
Translation: And deeds become necklaces around the necks

Arabic text: وَكَانَتِ الْقُبُورُ هِيَ الْمَأْوَى إِلَى مِيقَاتِ يَوْمِ التَّلَاقِ
Translation: And the graves become the shelter until the appointed time on the Day of Meeting

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِيْ حُلُوْلِ دَارِ الْبِلَى
Translation: And bless us in the dwelling of decay

Arabic text: وَطُولِ الْمُقَامَةِ بَيْنَ أَطْبَاقِ الثَّرَى
Translation: And the lengthy stay between the layers of the earth

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلِ الْقُبُورَ بَعْدَ فِرَاقِ الدُّنْيَا خَيْرَ مَنَازِلِنَا
Translation: And make our graves, after leaving this world, the best of our dwellings

Arabic text: وَافْسَحْ لَنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِيْ ضِيقِ مَلَاحِدِنَا
Translation: And make spacious for us, by Your mercy, our restricted tombs

Arabic text: وَلَا تَفْضَحْنَا فِيْ حَاضِرِيْ الْقِيَامَةِ بِمُوبِقَاتِ آثَامِنَا
Translation: And do not disgrace us in the presence of those attending the Resurrection with our destructive sins

Arabic text: وَارْحَمْ بِالْقُرْآنِ فِيْ مَوْقِفِ الْعَرْضِ عَلَيْكَ ذُلَّ مَقَامِنَا
Translation: And through the Quran, have mercy on the humiliation of our position in our standing before You

Arabic text: وَثَبِّتْ بِهِ عِنْدَ اضْطِرَابِ جِسْرِ جَهَنَّمَ
Translation: And through it make firm, when the bridge over Hell trembles

Arabic text: يَوْمَ الْمَجَازِ عَلَيْهَا زَلَلَ أَقْدَامِنَا
Translation: On the day of crossing over it, the slipping of our feet

Arabic text: وَنَوِّرْ بِهِ قَبْلَ الْبَعْثِ سُدَفَ قُبُورِنَا
Translation: And through it illuminate the darkness of our graves before the Resurrection

Arabic text: وَنَجِّنَا بِهِ مِنْ كُلِّ كَرْبٍ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
Translation: And deliver us through it from every distress on the Day of Resurrection

Arabic text: وَشَدَائِدِ أَهْوَالِ يَوْمِ الطَّامَّةِ
Translation: And from the severe terrors of the Day of Calamity

Arabic text: وَبَيِّضْ وُجُوهَنَا يَوْمَ تَسْوَدُّ وُجُوهُ الظَّلَمَةِ
Translation: And whiten our faces on the day when the faces of wrongdoers will be blackened

Arabic text: فِيْ يَوْمِ الْحَسْرَةِ وَالنَّدَامَةِ
Translation: On the day of regret and remorse

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْ لَنَا فِيْ صُدُورِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وُدًّا
Translation: And create love for us in the hearts of the believers

Arabic text: وَلَا تَجْعَلِ الْحَيَاةَ عَلَيْنَا نَكَدًا
Translation: And do not make life for us a burden

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad, Your servant and Your messenger

Arabic text: كَمَا بَلَّغَ رِسَالَتَكَ وَصَدَعَ بِأَمْرِكَ وَنَصَحَ لِعِبَادِكَ
Translation: As he delivered Your message, proclaimed Your command, and gave good counsel to Your servants

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ نَبِيَّنَا صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ
Translation: O Allah, make our Prophet, Your blessings be upon him

Arabic text: وَعَلَى آلِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَقْرَبَ النَّبِيِّينَ مِنْكَ مَجْلِسًا
Translation: And upon his family, on the Day of Resurrection, the nearest of the prophets to You in seat

Arabic text: وَأَمْكَنَهُمْ مِنْكَ شَفَاعَةً وَأَجَلَّهُمْ عِنْدَكَ قَدْرًا
Translation: And the most able in intercession with You, and the most eminent in rank with You

Arabic text: وَأَوْجَهَهُمْ عِنْدَكَ جَاهًا
Translation: And the most honored in status with You

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَشَرِّفْ بُنْيَانَهُ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and ennoble his edifice

Arabic text: وَعَظِّمْ بُرْهَانَهُ وَثَقِّلْ مِيزَانَهُ
Translation: And magnify his proof and make heavy his scale

Arabic text: وَتَقَبَّلْ شَفَاعَتَهُ وَقَرِّبْ وَسِيْلَتَهُ
Translation: And accept his intercession and bring near his means of approach

Arabic text: وَبَيِّضْ وَجْهَهُ وَأَتِمَّ نُورَهُ
Translation: And whiten his face and perfect his light

Arabic text: وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ وَأَحْيِنَا عَلَى سُنَّتِهِ
Translation: And raise his rank and revive us according to his tradition

Arabic text: وَتَوَفَّنَا عَلَى مِلَّتِهِ وَخُذْ بِنَا مِنْهَاجَهُ
Translation: And cause us to die following his religion and take us along his path

Arabic text: وَاسْلُكْ بِنَا سَبِيلَهُ وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ أَهْلِ طَاعَتِهِ
Translation: And make us travel his way and make us among the people who obey him

Arabic text: وَاحْشُرْنَا فِيْ زُمْرَتِهِ
Translation: And gather us in his company

Arabic text: وَأَوْرِدْنَا حَوْضَهُ وَاسْقِنَا بِكَأْسِهِ
Translation: And lead us to his pool and give us to drink from his cup

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: صَلَاةً تُبَلِّغُهُ بِهَا أَفْضَلَ
Translation: Blessings by which You convey to him the best

Arabic text: مَا يَأْمُلُ مِنْ خَيْرِكَ وَفَضْلِكَ وَكَرَامَتِكَ
Translation: Of what he hopes for of Your goodness, Your bounty, and Your generosity

Arabic text: إِنَّكَ ذُوْ رَحْمَةٍ وَاسِعَةٍ وَفَضْلٍ كَرِيمٍ
Translation: Indeed, You are the Possessor of vast mercy and noble bounty

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْزِهِ بِمَا بَلَّغَ مِنْ رِسَالَاتِكَ
Translation: O Allah, reward him for what he conveyed of Your messages

Arabic text: وَأَدَّى مِنْ آيَاتِكَ وَنَصَحَ لِعِبَادِكَ
Translation: And fulfilled of Your signs, and advised Your servants

Arabic text: وَجَاهَدَ فِيْ سَبِيلِكَ أَفْضَلَ مَا جَزَيْتَ
Translation: And strived in Your way, with the best of what You have rewarded

Arabic text: أَحَدًا مِنْ مَلَائِكَتِكَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ وَأَنْبِيَائِكَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ الْمُصْطَفَيْنَ
Translation: Any one of Your close angels and Your chosen sent prophets

Arabic text: وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الطَّاهِرِينَ
Translation: And peace be upon him and upon his pure and purified family

Arabic text: وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
Translation: And the mercy of Allah and His blessings
